name: jdMacroPlayer
tagline: Wayland compatible macro player for Linux
blurb: jdMacroPlayer allows you to create and execute Macros under Wayland and X11.
description:
jdMacroPlayer allows you to create and execute Macros under Wayland and X11. You can simulate Keybaord and Mouse input or execute a Command by pressing a Shortcut.

Please note that jdMacroPlayer requires bleeding-edge features, so it may not work with your desktop.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
